summary: RSS2EMail is a self-hosted tool written in Python that retrieves updates from RSS and Atom web feeds. It processes these entries and delivers new content directly to an email inbox, with support for OPML import files. This bridges traditional web syndication formats and email-based reading workflows.
goodFor: This is suitable if you prefer managing your feed subscriptions entirely through your email client rather than using a dedicated feed reader interface.
watchOut: The project exhibits very low maintenance activity and lacks a tagged release history, meaning you may encounter unresolved bugs or missing features without upstream patches. It also competes in a space with many active, better-known alternatives.
deployNotes: As a Python application packaged via Debian formats, you will typically need to ensure a persistent storage volume for your configuration and feed state. You should also configure a local mail transfer agent or SMTP relay settings so the script can successfully dispatch emails.
